description: This Java test class 'ProgressiveLoanTrancheTest' contains integration tests for progressive loan disbursement scenarios within the Apache Fineract project. It extends the base integration test class and uses helper methods to create clients, loan products, and handle disbursements. The test verifies proper loan disbursement behavior, including handling of multiple tranches and error conditions.

classes.name: ProgressiveLoanTrancheTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing progressive loan tranche disbursements in the Fineract project.

methods.name: testProgressiveLoanTrancheDisbursement
methods.description: Test method that performs a sequence of loan creation, approval, and staged disbursements, including handling expected failures and adjustments to disbursement details.
